findings.current: And his Disciple was fighting the Blood Lord, someone who absolutely could not die.
findings.defect: The sentence makes the Blood Lord, rather than Jeok Cheongang’s Disciple, the person who must not die.
findings.rationale: 결코 죽어서는 안 되는 modifies 제자.
findings.replacement: And his Disciple, who absolutely could not be allowed to die, was fighting the Blood Lord.
findings.source: 결코 죽어서는 안 되는 제자가 혈주와 싸우고 있다.

findings.current: the monstrous figure standing three yards tall
findings.defect: Three jang is approximately thirty feet, not three yards; the draft reduces the monster’s height to less than a third of its stated size.
findings.rationale: 삼 장 is about nine to ten meters.
findings.replacement: the monstrous figure standing nearly thirty feet tall
findings.source: 무려 삼 장에 달하는 거구의 괴물도

findings.current: “I’ll kill you for him. Even if it isn’t today.”
findings.defect: “Him” assigns a gender to the unidentified 그분.
findings.rationale: The source does not identify 그분 as male.
findings.replacement: “For that person’s sake, I’ll kill you. Even if it isn’t today.”
findings.source: “그분을 위해서라도 반드시 당신을 죽일 거야. 당장 오늘이 아니더라도.”

findings.current: A dagger the Slaughter Saint had just thrown was buried deep in the eye slit of the helmet pulled so low that not even the man’s face was visible.
findings.defect: The dagger is lodged between the helmet’s eyeholes, not in an eye slit.
findings.rationale: 눈구멍 사이 specifies the space between the eyeholes.
findings.replacement: A dagger the Slaughter Saint had just thrown was buried deep between the eyeholes of the helmet, which was pulled so low that not even the man’s face was visible.
findings.source: 얼굴조차 보이지 않게 깊게 눌러쓴 투구의 눈구멍 사이에는, 조금 전 살성이 쏘아 보낸 비수 한 자루가 깊숙이 박혀 있었다.

findings.current: A white flash, too bright to believe it was flame, filled his vision.
findings.defect: The surprising quality is the flash’s whiteness, not its brightness.
findings.rationale: 믿을 수 없을 만큼 새하얀 describes its color; 시야를 가렸다 says it obscured his view.
findings.replacement: A flash so impossibly white it was hard to believe it was flame blocked his view.
findings.source: 화염이라고 하기에는 믿을 수 없을 만큼 새하얀 섬광이 시야를 가렸다.

findings.current: “If my one and only Disciple is playing, shouldn’t I be able to play with fire a hundred or even a thousand times?”
findings.defect: “Is playing” loses Jeok’s teasing image of his Disciple performing antics for him, which answers the Grand Mage’s remark about watching grandchildren.
findings.rationale: 재롱을 부린다 echoes 손주 재롱 and keeps Jeok’s affectionate comeback.
findings.replacement: “If my one and only Disciple is putting on a show for me, I can play with fire a hundred times over. A thousand, even.”
findings.source: “하나뿐인 제자 놈이 재롱을 부린다는데, 그깟 불장난이야 백번 천번도 할 수 있지 않겠느냐?”

summary: The draft misassigns who must survive, specifies an unidentified person's gender, and changes several physical details.
